title: Dispatcher crash before submit
detection: Expired generation-1 claim is detected on the next dispatcher cycle, bounded by the configured claim TTL.
containment: The immutable derived run id and generation fence prevent an unfenced retry.
recovery: A second holder acquires generation 2 and submits exactly one attempt-1 run.

auditRefs.caseName: takes over after-claim-before-submit with one derived Harness run

title: Dispatcher crash after submit before binding write
detection: The expired submitted claim is observed on the next dispatcher cycle after its TTL.
containment: The derived run id makes the retry an idempotent lookup rather than a second run.
recovery: The contender adopts the attempt-1 run and writes the missing immutable binding.

auditRefs.caseName: takes over after-submit-before-binding by adopting one existing run

title: Duplicate webhook/event
detection: Repeated and out-of-order reads are compared against durable task and decision state in the same reconciliation batch.
containment: Projection remains monotonic and decision persistence remains idempotent.
recovery: Replay converges to one binding, one lifecycle transition, one handoff decision, and no alert.

auditRefs.caseName: replays duplicate and out-of-order events without duplicate control effects

title: Harness/DBOS unavailable
detection: The independent watchdog probes the Harness Postgres boundary each cycle.
containment: The watchdog remains outside the dispatcher and Hermes failure domains.
recovery: Operator restores the Harness data source; forwarding resumes without dispatcher mutation.

auditRefs.caseName: alerts on either unreachable Postgres boundary without stopping itself

title: Harness worker killed mid-run
detection: A durable capability completion is observed before SIGKILL and the watchdog reports the source gap on its next thresholded cycle.
containment: DBOS resumes the same run and the Harness event store must contain one CapabilityCompleted row per invocation id.
recovery: A replacement worker drives the original run to a terminal outcome.

auditRefs.caseName: kills and restarts the pinned Harness worker without duplicating a protected effect

title: Board unavailable
detection: The dispatcher advances durable state while no board consumer is running; the board replay is fingerprinted against every control table.
containment: The board path has read-only dependencies and no control authority.
recovery: Restarted projection reads the terminal task and performs zero store writes.

auditRefs.caseName: keeps execution durable through board outage and replays with zero writes

title: Policy changes after approval
detection: The active version/hash identity is compared before submit and on each reconciliation of a bound run.
containment: Pre-submit work is blocked; bound immutable work is warned and never cancelled.
recovery: Operator reviews the visible drift status and proposes a new approved task version when required.

auditRefs.caseName: refuses pre-submit policy drift and flags a bound run without cancelling

title: Approval/task hash mismatch
detection: The approval payload hash is recomputed before any claim or submit.
containment: The task is blocked before Harness receives authority.
recovery: Operator creates and approves a correct immutable task version.

auditRefs.caseName: refuses an approval-hash mismatch before claim or submit

title: Capability expansion
detection: Typed attenuation compares the requested grants with the pinned profile before submit.
containment: Any undeclared or delegating capability blocks dispatch.
recovery: Operator narrows the task/profile and approves a new version.

auditRefs.caseName: accepts a seven-capability profile with strictly narrower authority
rejects memory.propose in the outer production profile loader

title: Budget/deadline exhaustion
detection: Projection compares measured elapsed time, tokens, and calls with the approved limits every reconciliation.
containment: Live overruns are cancelled; already-terminal verified work preserves its truthful result with an overrun warning.
recovery: Operator reviews the named dimension and decides whether a new task version is justified.

auditRefs.caseName: preserves a verified terminal handoff after a measured token overrun
D4: cancels and fails a live budget-exhausted run with one alert

title: Global HALT during run
detection: HALT is checked before dispatch and before each active-run reconciliation.
containment: The live run is cancelled and no handoff is created.
recovery: Only the operator removes HALT and authorizes later work.

auditRefs.caseName: HALT cancels a bound live run and never creates a handoff

title: Verifier outage
detection: The current deterministic verifier is in-process with the worker, so no separately unavailable verifier boundary exists to detect.
containment: Missing or invalid verification already prevents a verified handoff, but that is not an outage drill.
recovery: The future separately wired judge must define retry and operator escalation without treating absence as acceptance.

auditRefs.caseName: marks completed-but-unverified work failed without a handoff

deferred.reason: A separate verifier outage cannot be injected honestly because the deterministic verifier runs in-process with the worker. The existing invalid-handoff refusal proves containment only; it does not prove detection or recovery for a boundary that is not wired.

title: Verification timeout
detection: Bounded command execution converts a missed verifier deadline into a typed timeout.
containment: The timeout remains a retryable failure and never becomes acceptance.
recovery: The operator reviews the timed-out run before any new task version.

auditRefs.caseName: preserves retryable timeout failures

title: Verifier rejects output
detection: The independent verification report records required failed criteria.
containment: The task fails with zero handoff decisions.
recovery: Operator inspects evidence and decides whether to approve a new task version.

auditRefs.caseName: rejects the negative fixture on its merits with no handoff

title: Malicious/oversized event
detection: The bounded Harness read port rejects oversized output and stable poison fingerprints reach quarantine at the configured cycle threshold.
containment: The binding is durably quarantined and secret-shaped content is absent from alerts and pilot status.
recovery: The watchdog and read-only pilot remain available while the operator inspects and explicitly clears the marker.

auditRefs.caseName: quarantines oversized secret-shaped output without leaking to sinks

title: Conflicting run binding
detection: Dispatcher and independent watchdog derive the intended id and compare it with durable bindings.
containment: The work item receives a durable quarantine marker and critical alert.
recovery: Operator resolves the binding and explicitly unquarantines the task.

auditRefs.caseName: marks a conflicting binding while the independent watchdog alerts

title: PR head changes after handoff
detection: The sender rechecks live base/head identity immediately before actuation.
containment: Drift refuses instead of rebasing or sending a mismatched payload.
recovery: Operator rebuilds a new payload from a newly approved task when appropriate.

auditRefs.caseName: refuses base drift introduced after payload construction

title: PR API failure
detection: Remote state is queried by derived head before every create/retry.
containment: A crash after create can leave at most one PR.
recovery: Retry adopts the existing exact payload and converges.

auditRefs.caseName: converges after a crash following remote creation

title: Averray control-plane outage
detection: No Averray control-plane call exists on the supervised Harness dispatch path today, so there is no live boundary to make unavailable.
containment: The current path cannot mutate the absent boundary; that absence is not outage containment evidence.
recovery: The packet that wires the economic control-plane seam must add bounded detection, refusal, and operator recovery.

deferred.reason: An outage drill would be fake while Harness dispatch makes no Averray control-plane call. The future packet that introduces that authority inherits the disposable outage drill before the seam can be enabled.

title: Settlement replay
detection: Settlement is not wired to Harness dispatch, so no integration replay can currently be observed here.
containment: Averray-side idempotency mechanisms exist outside this integration, but they are context rather than this drill's evidence.
recovery: The economic-seam packet must replay the same settlement intent against the real integrated store and prove one effect.

deferred.reason: The integration has no settlement submission path to replay. External idempotency evidence does not prove this repository's future binding, so the wiring packet inherits an exactly-once replay drill.

title: Direct fallback after Harness failure
detection: Direct fallback is an operator policy decision and no automatic fallback seam is enabled.
containment: The current system fails closed instead of silently expanding authority to a direct agent.
recovery: INT-5's fallback-retirement ceremony must decide and evidence any explicit successor path.

deferred.reason: There is deliberately no automatic direct fallback to inject. A drill before the operator's INT-5 decision would invent authority that the system does not possess.

title: Hermes unavailable
detection: The standalone watchdog continues source probes and direct forwarding while Hermes-facing containers are absent.
containment: No watchdog import or credential depends on Hermes or slack-operator.
recovery: Hermes may restart independently; watchdog alert delivery never waits for it.

auditRefs.caseName: has no slack-operator or Hermes-facing import
